name: moon
description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The filled exterior is the analytical .85-unit outward offset of the revised Outline at Regular 1.70: outer radius 8.85, concave radius 9.15, and radius-.85 joins centered on the original horns. The radius-10 Outline concavity is offset toward its own center by .85. The outer circle center, horn endpoints and native translation are retained. The inner arc has a deeper indentation than the radius-12 revision, as requested by the owner; the default stroke weight and overall dimensions are unchanged. No style-specific scaling or translation is used. Native X/Y=100% and rotation=0 are the reference. Compare contours at equal rotation. Draft awaiting owner review.
